title: They Moved Xi'an's 600-Year-Old Bell Tower 1,000 m. Worth It? | China Travel Expert
description:
In 1582, Xi'an took its Bell Tower apart and rebuilt it 1,000 metres east. Genius city planning, or Ming money to burn?

The Bell Tower was first built in 1384, early in the Ming dynasty, standing near the Drum Tower. As the walled city kept growing, its real geographic centre shifted — so in 1582 the entire timber tower was dismantled piece by piece and reassembled 1,000 metres east, at the crossing of the four main avenues. Only the brick base is new; it has held that spot for more than four centuries since.

🧭 Expert Tip: come at dusk — the Bell Tower and the Drum Tower face each other across the same square, so you can see both lit from one spot.
